I read the incident review note. Now let me tally up the problems by service from the last 7 days. Here are the Dynatrace services ordered by number of problems:

| # | Service | Entity ID | Problems (7d) | Type |
|---|---------|-----------|---------------|------|

| 2 | **hello-world-demo** | SERVICE-DE2CD591EA5A5EFA | ~58 | Failure rate increase (recurring, up to 100%) |
| 3 | **DynaTraceLambdaApiGatewayEnvi-ItemsHandlerFB09CCF4-ZKWCOYSuSedr** (us-west-2) | SERVICE-604A99F5338C9A07 | ~17 | Lambda failures (`'version'` exception) + failure rate increase |
| 4 | **hello-world-demo** (2nd instance) | SERVICE-FDFAFD73F4B6879D | 6 | Failure rate increase (100% spikes) |
| 5 | **hello-world-demo** (3rd instance) | SERVICE-C896BBEF276DB8A1 | 3 | Failure rate increase |
| 6 | **TradeManagement / BrokerService / NotMiningBitcoin** | multiple | 2 | Response time degradation (~900ms vs 100ms threshold) |
| 7 | **ingestion-demo-s3-writer** (us-west-2) | SERVICE-0BC129A7436EB144 | 1 | Lambda S3 AccessDenied (ACTIVE) |
| 8 | **travelbooker** | SERVICE-B12E40CC151805BF | 1 | Failure rate increase (80%) |

Key observations:
- **requestlogger** and **hello-world-demo** are by far the noisiest — they're generating problems every 30-60 minutes around the clock. These look like chronic issues, not one-off incidents.
- The Lambda `ItemsHandler` keeps failing with `Exception: 'version'` — likely a code bug or missing config.
- The `ingestion-demo-s3-writer` has an ACTIVE problem since March 3 — it's an IAM permission issue (missing `s3:PutObject`).

Regarding your incident review note from 3/15 — the checkout-service latency spike around 14:00 UTC doesn't directly match any of these service names. The closest problem on 3/15 is P-2603543 (the Lambda ItemsHandler failure rate at 17:24 UTC). Want me to dig deeper into a specific timeframe or service for the incident review?
